name: @lightwebinc/bbox-host
description: The bbox record layer in TypeScript and the host module for an overlay host: envelope and receipt records, the BRC-169 content and its JSON subset, office and box names, lookup questions, the topic manager's transaction rules and the recipient's payment checks, held to the Go codec's vectors, and tm_bbox with ls_bbox as a module the host loads by path

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run bundle
